data: Which of the following months has the largest difference between the red and blue lines?

To determine which month has the largest difference between the red and blue lines, I need to compare the values of the two lines at each point in time. The red line represents the number of users, and the blue line represents the number of questions. The difference between these two lines is the absolute value of their difference at each point in time.

From the data provided:
- In June 2018, there were approximately 208,744 users and 9,527 questions.
- In May 2019, there were approximately 878,896 users and 10,407 questions.

The difference between the number of users and the number of questions is:
- In June 2018: |208,744 - 9,527| = 199,217
- In May 2019: |878,896 - 10,407| = 868,489

The largest difference occurs in May 2019. Therefore, the month with the largest difference between the red and blue lines is May 2019.
